newsitem.title: USA: Net $13 mln of U.S. securities stripped in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Net $13 mln of U.S. securities stripped in Dec.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday a net $13 million of government securities were stripped in December, compared with $4.1 billion that were reconstituted in November.

The Strips, or Separate Trading of Registered Interest and Principal of Securities program, are created by separating the interest coupon from the principal payment. Securities can be reconstituted by rejoining the principal and coupon.
The Treasury said $928.14 billion of securities were eligible for stripping in December. Of the total, $223.15 billion were held in stripped form on Dec 31, compared with $223.14 billion on Nov 30.
